title: Formal smoothness transfer for a compatible map of local completions
statement: Let φ : A → B be a local homomorphism of Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] commutative local rings, and ψ : Â → B̂ a ring homomorphism between their maximal-ideal adic completions [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] with the coordinate compatibility of lem-weil-pbc-fs-adic-completion-map-local. If B is formally smooth over A for the m_B-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic], then B̂ is formally smooth over Â via ψ for the (m_B B̂)-adic topology.

proof.text: Coordinate compatibility and ext_evalₐ give ψ(ι_A(a)) = ι_B(φ(a)). Locality and ideal map identities imply ψ((m_A Â)^n) ⊆ (m_B B̂)^n. The algebra structures are therefore compatible.

Noetherianity makes m_B finitely generated [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Apply Algebra.FormallySmoothAdic.adicCompletion [lem-weil-pbc-fs-adic-completion] to obtain formal smoothness of B̂ over A. Restrict a lifting problem over Â to A and obtain an A-algebra lift f : B̂ → D.

If g kills (m_B B̂)^k, the quotient-lift identity puts f((m_B B̂)^k) in J. Squaring and J² = 0 show that f kills (m_B B̂)^(k+k). The commutativity of g with the Â-structure map and the ideal inclusion likewise put the image of (m_A Â)^k in J, so Â → D kills (m_A Â)^(k+k). This is Tag 07EC.

Mathlib AdicCompletion.pow_smul_top_eq_ker_eval [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-mod-power] identifies the kernel of evalₐ at k+k with (m_A Â)^(k+k). Choose a representative a in A of the quotient coordinate of x. Thus x−ι_A(a) belongs to this power. Both f∘ψ and the structure map kill this difference and agree on ι_A(a) by A-linearity. They agree for all x, making f an Â-algebra map; its unchanged reduction is g.
